UPDATE tender_analysis_intake_events AS event
SET status = 'failed',
    error_message = left($2, 2000),
    updated_at = now()
WHERE event.id = (
  SELECT owned.id
  FROM tender_analysis_intake_events AS owned
  WHERE owned.n8n_execution_id = $1
    AND owned.status = 'processing'
)
RETURNING
    event.id,
    event.event_key,
    event.analysis_run_id,
    event.status;
